name: Mila
source:
Mila is a young girl who lives with her grandmother, Minnie. (It is unclear what happened to her birth family.) Despite still being a high-school student she works several odd jobs to help her grandmother make ends meet. She works as a barista at the local coffee shop, she does deliveries for dr. Patel's clinic, and she delivers pizza for her grandmother's pizzeria. The first time we meet her she is being berated by Karen Samson at the coffee shop and, after the Main Character intervenes and teaches Karen a lesson, since then Mila refers to MC as "my hero".

Mila is a very classic redhead; fiery orange hair, green eyes, pale skin and freckles over half her body. She keeps her long hair braided into a ponytail that reaches her waist. (Unbraided, it must be much longer.) She is fairly short (although not as ridiculously short as her grandmother) and has a petite build.

In school, she is on the gymnastics team together with Isabella, Polly, and Sophia.

A while later, the protagonist encounters Mila as she has sprained her foot (but her foot is plastered which looks a bit excessive for a sprain) and gives her a piggyback ride home. He also manages to give her an orgasm during the ride by running (which causes her to grind herself on his back). When she discovers that she forgot her keys, the protagonist searches around the house and finds that her bedroom window is loose enough that he can jiggle the lock open and get in, letting her in from the inside. As he tells her where he got in, she surprises him by getting strongly aroused by the though of him being able to get into her room at night at will and do whatever he wanted with her. In fact, she has multiple orgasms from just imagining it! (Then again, Mila seems to have it very easy to orgasm.) He promises to visit her some night and also gives her a safeword.
